title: Trust Looks Like This
vol: Mommy Is Human Too · Book Nine
verse: "Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things…"

pages.text:
Grandma came to watch the little ones while Mommy stepped away,
and Mommy knelt by Jojo: "I have a job for you today.

The dishes need a rinsing, and the toys go in the chest,
and Biscuit's bowl needs water — then you're free to do the rest.

I've shown you how a hundred times. I know you know the way.
I trust you, Jojo. That's why I can leave the job with you today."

But Pip found blocks, and Bee found paint, and Biscuit found a shoe,
and Jojo thought, "I'll get to it. There's plenty time — it's true."

He played a game. He built a fort. The clock kept ticking by.
The dishes sat. The toys stayed out. The water bowl went dry.

Then Biscuit nudged his empty bowl and gave a little whine,
and Jojo's tummy flipped inside: "Oh no — that job is mine!"

He thought of Mommy's face that morning, kneeling down to say, "I trust" —
and something in him stood up tall: "I can. I will. I must."

He filled the bowl up to the top. He rinsed each cup and spoon.
He gathered every block and car, and hummed a working tune.

And Pip came by to help a bit, and Bee just clapped her hands,
and Jojo showed them how it's done — the way a big kid stands.

When Mommy's key turned in the door, she stopped and looked around:
the dishes dried, the toys put up — not one mess to be found.

"You did it, Jojo — thoroughly!" she said with shining eyes.
And Jojo told the truth: "I played at first." She smiled. "That's wise.

Telling the truth is part of trust, and finishing is too.
Well done, my good and faithful son — there's more I'll trust to you."

Then Mommy sat down on the couch and let her shoulders fall:
"I'm tired, too. Some days I need a helper most of all."

Because your Mommy trusts you, and she needs you to come through —
and Mommy needs a helper sometimes… because she's human too.

verses: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much.
And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men.
Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
